listing.name: WWF SmackDown! 2 — WWF-SmackDown-2-Recomp (fabioap-cpu)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Upstream rendering/input/memory-card playable; USAonly, other regions untested; performance slogan unqualified. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA WWF SmackDown! 2 CUE/BIN. The exact supported revision is not stated; check the project’s requirements before setup. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the advertised release and place your own disc in its extracted folder. Set the CUE path in game.toml, then start WWF-SmackDown-2-Recomp.exe. Portcove does not manage this download and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: The project describes playable rendering, input and memory cards for the USA edition only. Other regions are untested, and the performance slogan has not been confirmed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
